evidence: Plaut. Men. 5.2.70: num hinc ēmigrāstī? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically to move out of a house or a place; used now for leaving one’s country.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 309.
